attributes.title: Cluster resource report: capacity
attributes.description: Tiles, capacity by requests with N+1, per cluster, from OpenTelemetry metrics. Generated by kibana/build_dashboard.py in cluster-resource-allocation.
attributes.panelsJSON:
[{"type": "visualization", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 48, "h": 4, "i": "p0"}, "panelIndex": "p0", "embeddableConfig": {"savedVis": {"title": "", "description": "", "type": "markdown", "uiState": {}, "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": false, "markdown": "**Cluster resource report: capacity**, as in the in-cluster dashboard of the cluster-resource-report chart, on the OpenTelemetry metrics. *Requested* = requests of running pods (averaged over the time range); *used* = P95 over the time range; tiles marked *now* = the last 10 minutes of the range. *N+1*: allocatable − largest node − platform (System) requests = room for projects. Control-plane nodes and the pods on them are left out (the filter above the panels). Project names from the lookup index `rancher-projects`. Docs: `guides/kibana-dashboard.md`.

Dashboards: **Cluster resource report: capacity** · [Cluster resource report: projects](#/view/cra-cluster-resource-projects) · [Workload limits: limit ≤ 2× request](#/view/cra-workload-limits)"}, "data": {"aggs": [], "searchSource": {}}}, "hidePanelTitles": true, "enhancements": {}}}, {"type": "lens", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 4, "w": 6, "h": 5, "i": "p1"}, "panelIndex": "p1", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "Clusters", "visualizationType": "lnsMetric", "type": "lens", "references": [], "state": {"datasourceStates": {"textBased": {"layers": {"layer_0": {"index": "cra-otel-metrics-esql", "query": {"esql": "FROM metrics-*.otel-*
| WHERE metrics.k8s.node.allocatable_cpu IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.node.allocatable_memory IS NOT NULL
     OR metrics.k8s.container.cpu_request IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.container.memory_request IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.container.cpu_limit IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.container.memory_limit IS NOT NULL

     OR metrics.k8s.resource_quota.hard_limit IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.hpa.max_replicas IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.namespace.phase IS NOT NULL
| EVAL cluster = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name, "(unknown)"), project = COALESCE(resource.attributes.rancher.project.id, "(no project)"), namespace = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.name, ""),
       entity = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.pod.uid, resource.attributes.k8s.resourcequota.uid, resource.attributes.k8s.hpa.uid, resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.uid, resource.attributes.k8s.node.name), container = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.container.name, ""),

| EVAL phase_now = CASE(recent, metrics.k8s.pod.phase), c_now = CASE(recent AND metrics.k8s.container.restarts IS NOT NULL, 1),
       rq_now = CASE(recent AND metrics.k8s.resource_quota.hard_limit IS NOT NULL, 1), hpa_now = CASE(recent AND metrics.k8s.hpa.max_replicas IS NOT NULL, 1),
       ns_now = CASE(recent AND metrics.k8s.namespace.phase IS NOT NULL, 1)
| STATS alloc_cpu = MAX(metrics.k8s.node.allocatable_cpu), alloc_mem = MAX(metrics.k8s.node.allocatable_memory),
        req_cpu = MAX(metrics.k8s.container.cpu_request), req_mem = MAX(metrics.k8s.container.memory_request), lim_cpu = MAX(metrics.k8s.container.cpu_limit), lim_mem = MAX(metrics.k8s.container.memory_limit),

  BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend), cluster, project, namespace, entity, container
| EVAL is_c = CASE(c_now == 1 AND container != "", 1, 0),
       no_cpu = CASE(c_now == 1 AND container != "" AND req_cpu IS NULL, 1, 0),
       no_mem_lim = CASE(c_now == 1 AND container != "" AND lim_mem IS NULL, 1, 0),
       any_set = CASE(container != "" AND COALESCE(req_cpu, req_mem, lim_cpu, lim_mem) IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)

        lim_mem = SUM(lim_mem), use_cpu = SUM(use_cpu), use_mem = SUM(use_mem), phase = MAX(phase),
        phase_now = MAX(phase_now), containers = SUM(is_c), no_cpu = SUM(no_cpu), no_mem_lim = SUM(no_mem_lim),
        any_set = MAX(any_set), rq = MAX(rq_now), hpa = MAX(hpa_now), ns_now = MAX(ns_now)
  BY t, cluster, project, namespace, entity
| EVAL req_cpu = TO_DOUBLE(req_cpu), req_mem = TO_DOUBLE(req_mem), lim_mem = TO_DOUBLE(lim_mem),
       run = CASE(phase == 1 OR phase >= 3, 0.0, 1.0)
| EVAL rc = req_cpu * run, rm = req_mem * run, lm = lim_mem * run,
       pend_cpu = CASE(phase_now == 1, req_cpu, 0.0), pend_mem = CASE(phase_now == 1, req_mem, 0.0),
       pods = CASE(phase_now == 2, 1, 0), pending = CASE(phase_now == 1, 1, 0),

| EVAL pname = COALESCE(project_name, project)

| EVAL rc_t = CASE(category == "System", 0.0, rc), rm_t = CASE(category == "System", 0.0, rm),

       ns_u = CASE(category == "Unassigned" AND ns_now == 1, namespace)
| STATS alloc_cpu = SUM(alloc_cpu), alloc_mem = SUM(alloc_mem), largest_cpu = MAX(alloc_cpu),
        largest_mem = MAX(alloc_mem), nodes = COUNT(alloc_cpu), rc = SUM(rc), rm = SUM(rm),
        rc_t = SUM(rc_t), rm_t = SUM(rm_t), rc_s = SUM(rc_s), rm_s = SUM(rm_s), rc_u = SUM(rc_u), rm_u = SUM(rm_u),
        use_cpu = SUM(use_cpu), use_mem = SUM(use_mem), pend_cpu = SUM(pend_cpu), pend_mem = SUM(pend_mem),
        containers = SUM(containers), no_cpu = SUM(no_cpu), no_mem_lim = SUM(no_mem_lim),
        ns_u = COUNT_DISTINCT(ns_u)
  BY t, cluster
| STATS alloc_cpu = AVG(alloc_cpu), alloc_mem = AVG(alloc_mem), largest_cpu = AVG(largest_cpu),
        largest_mem = AVG(largest_mem), nodes = MAX(nodes), rc = AVG(rc), rm = AVG(rm),
        rc_t = AVG(rc_t), rm_t = AVG(rm_t), rc_s = AVG(rc_s), rm_s = AVG(rm_s), rc_u = AVG(rc_u), rm_u = AVG(rm_u),
        uc = PERCENTILE(use_cpu, 95), um = PERCENTILE(use_mem, 95), pend_cpu = MAX(pend_cpu),
        pend_mem = MAX(pend_mem), containers = MAX(containers), no_cpu = MAX(no_cpu),
        no_mem_lim = MAX(no_mem_lim), ns_u = MAX(ns_u)
  BY cluster
| EVAL room_cpu = GREATEST(alloc_cpu - largest_cpu - rc_s, 0), room_mem = GREATEST(alloc_mem - largest_mem - rm_s, 0)
| STATS `Clusters` = COUNT(*)"}, "timeField": "@timestamp", "columns": [{"columnId": "value", "fieldName": "Clusters", "meta": {"type": "number"}}], "allColumns": [{"columnId": "value", "fieldName": "Clusters", "meta": {"type": "number"}}]}}}}, "internalReferences": [], "filters": [], "query": {"esql": "FROM metrics-*.otel-*

attributes.title: Workload limits: limit ≤ 2× request
attributes.description: Every workload checked against a LimitRange maxLimitRequestRatio of 2, from OpenTelemetry metrics. Generated by kibana/build_dashboard.py in cluster-resource-allocation.

Kubernetes would reject its next pod (restart, rollout, scale-up, drain) when a container has a limit above 2× its request, or a request without a limit (unless the LimitRange sets a default limit); a limit without a request passes (the request becomes the limit). Problems first; *CPU* only matters if the ratio is set for CPU too. Control-plane nodes and the pods on them are left out (the filter above the panels). Project names from the lookup index `rancher-projects`.
